exposure: Overweight or obese mother and underweight child (OWOBM/UWC)
Overweight or obese mother and stunted child (OWOBM/STC)
Overweight or obese mother and wasted child (OWOBM/WSC)
finding: Although the prevalence of MCDB of malnutrition in Bangladesh is low (6.3%), several sociodemographic factors were associated with increased odds of OWOBM/UWC, OWOBM/STC, and OWOBM/USWC.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery was significantly associated with OWOBM/USWC.
